name: opnsense
description: Read and (with explicit confirmation) change an OPNsense firewall through its HTTP API. Stdio MCP server in Go (standard library only) plus a skill.

OPNSENSE_URL.title: OPNsense base URL
OPNSENSE_URL.description: Scheme and host only, e.g. https://192.168.1.1 or https://[2001:db8::1]. No /api suffix.

OPNSENSE_API_KEY.title: API key
OPNSENSE_API_KEY.description: OPNsense API key (System > Access > Users > API keys). Sent as the basic-auth username.

OPNSENSE_API_SECRET.title: API secret
OPNSENSE_API_SECRET.description: OPNsense API secret. Sent as the basic-auth password.

OPNSENSE_VERIFY_TLS.title: Verify TLS certificate
OPNSENSE_VERIFY_TLS.description: "true" to verify the firewall's certificate; "false" accepts a self-signed cert.
